title: Doğal Konuşma & Hikâye
goalTr: Robot gibi konuşmayı bırak: dolgu kelimeleri, fikir kalıpları ve hikâye bağlaçlarıyla doğal konuş.

chunks.ex: Actually, this is my first time in Bali.
So basically, we got completely lost.
I guess it depends on the traffic.
I mean, it's expensive, but it's worth it.
Did you see everything? — Pretty much.

chunks.use: Cümle sonunda da olur: '..., to be honest.'
chunks.ex: I'm not really into clubs, to be honest.
By the way, what's your name?
It rained all day — but at least it was warm.
I feel like Ubud is more relaxed than Canggu.
I'd rather stay by the beach.

chunks.en: The best thing about it is ___.

chunks.ex: I ended up staying there all day.
Turns out the beach was closed.

chunks.tr: Ben de dedim ki ___ / şok oldum.
chunks.ex: I was like, 'No way, this can't be happening.'

quick.q: Do you like the food here?
quick.sample: Honestly, I love it. Especially the nasi goreng.
Good question. Probably beach — but I love both.

quick.q: What do you think of Canggu?
quick.sample: It's cool, but kind of crowded, to be honest.

quick.q: Do you prefer quiet places or parties?
quick.sample: I'm more into quiet places, honestly.
Pretty much! Greener than I expected, actually.

quick.q: What's the best thing about your country?
quick.sample: The food, definitely. And the coastline.

quick.q: What's one thing you don't like here?
quick.sample: The traffic, I guess. It's kind of crazy.
I feel like I could, honestly. At least for a year.

quick.q: What's your favorite food so far?
quick.sample: Mie goreng, pretty much every day.
Totally worth it. The only problem is the stairs!

social.stmt: I rode a scooter in the rain for two hours.
samples: Oh no, that sounds miserable! Did you get soaked?
Haha, welcome to Bali! Was it scary?

social.stmt: Apparently there's a ceremony in the village tonight.
samples: Oh really? Can tourists go?
That sounds interesting. How did you hear about it?

social.stmt: I paid double the price because I forgot to bargain.
samples: Haha, we've all been there. At least you know for next time!
Classic! How much was it?

social.stmt: The funny thing is, we got completely lost.
samples: Haha, no way. How did you find your way back?
And then what happened?

social.stmt: I ended up staying an extra week.
samples: Wait, seriously? What made you stay?
That's amazing. Was it worth it?

social.stmt: I'm not really into beach clubs.
samples: Fair enough! Me neither, honestly. I'd rather find a quiet beach. Do you know any?

social.stmt: I feel like Ubud is better than Canggu.
samples: I know what you mean. I liked Ubud too. What's the best thing about it for you?

social.stmt: Komik veya ters giden bir seyahat anını 30 saniyede anlat. Bağlaçları kullan: At first... / Then... / Turns out... / In the end...
samples: So basically...
At first everything was fine, then...
Turns out...
I ended up...
The funny thing is...

social.stmt: Bali'ye gelmeye nasıl karar verdiğini kısa bir hikâye gibi anlat.
samples: Honestly, at first I was thinking of...
Then a friend told me...
I ended up booking it in, like, two days.

grammar.title: Tercih & görüş: I'd rather / more into / It depends

intro.ex: I'd rather go to the beach today. (tercih)
I'm not really into clubs. (kibar ret)

drills.best: I'm not really into clubs, to be honest.

drills.tr: Ben daha çok sakin yerleri severim.

drills.best: I'd rather stay at the beach today.
I think it's totally worth it.

listening.audio: Honestly, it wasn't really worth it.
I ended up staying there all day.

scenario.title: Gün Batımı Hikâyeleri
scenario.situationTr: Plaj barında gün batımı. Yanındaki gezgin başından geçen bir olayı anlatıyor — sen de kendi hikâyeni anlatacaksın.
scenario.goalTr: Tepki ver, takip sorusu sor, SONRA kendi hikâyeni bağlaçlarla anlat (at first / turns out / I ended up).

personas.name: Charlie
personas.story: my wallet fell into the ocean on a boat trip
personas.detail: a local fisherman actually found it the next day

personas.name: Maya
personas.story: a monkey stole my sunglasses at the temple
personas.detail: I had to trade a banana to get them back

personas.name: Finn
personas.story: our scooter ran out of petrol in the middle of nowhere
personas.detail: a family invited us for dinner while we waited

beats.ai: This sunset is unreal, right? I'm {name}, by the way.
beats.tr: Bu gün batımı inanılmaz, değil mi? Bu arada ben {name}.

beats.ai: So you'll never believe what happened to me this week — {story}.
beats.tr: Bu hafta başıma geleni asla tahmin edemezsin — {story}.

beats.ai: I know, right?! And the funny thing is — {detail}.
beats.sample: Haha, that's crazy! That would only happen in Bali.

beats.ai: Honestly, it's a good story now. Anyway — has anything crazy happened to you here yet?
beats.tr: Açıkçası artık iyi bir hikâye oldu. Neyse — senin başına çılgın bir şey geldi mi?
beats.sample: Actually, yes! So basically... (kendi hikâyeni anlat!)

beats.ai: Haha, no way! And then what happened?
beats.tr: Haha, yok artık! Peki sonra ne oldu?
beats.sample: In the end, it worked out fine. I ended up laughing about it.

beats.ai: That's brilliant. So how are you finding Bali overall?
beats.tr: Harikaymış. Peki genel olarak Bali nasıl gidiyor?
beats.sample: Honestly, I love it. I feel like it's exactly what I needed.

beats.ai: Same here. Kuta's a bit much for me though, to be honest.
beats.tr: Bende de öyle. Ama Kuta bana biraz fazla geldi açıkçası.
beats.sample: I know what you mean. I'd rather stay around here.

beats.ai: Exactly. Anyway, I'm gonna grab another drink — you want one?
beats.tr: Aynen. Neyse, ben bir içecek daha alacağım — sen ister misin?

beats.ai: Coming right up. Cheers to Bali, yeah?
